scope.disambiguation_notes: The query refers to both blockchain and distributed ledger technology, which are often used interchangeably but can have distinct meanings. Blockchain is a type of distributed ledger technology, so the scope includes both the specific blockchain implementations and the broader category of distributed ledgers.
initial_task_hypotheses: The technology must enable the secure and immutable recording of transactions across a distributed network.
It must facilitate consensus among distributed nodes to validate transactions without a central authority.
The system should provide transparency and traceability of transactions to all participants in the network.
It must ensure data integrity and prevent unauthorized alterations to the ledger.
The technology should support the execution of smart contracts, which are self-executing contracts with the terms of the agreement directly written into code.

search_plan.rationale: To discover the fundamental techniques and methods used in implementing blockchain and distributed ledger systems.

search_plan.query_en: applications of blockchain and distributed ledger technology
search_plan.rationale: To explore the different areas and industries where blockchain and distributed ledger technology is applied.

search_plan.query_en: technologies similar to blockchain but not distributed ledger
search_plan.rationale: To identify technologies that are similar to blockchain but do not perform the defining tasks of distributed ledgers, such as traditional databases.
